instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Salt extraction and refining facility producing 25,000 tons of industrial and food-grade salt annually from marine evaporation pans. Weather-dependent production cycles create significant forecasting challenges due to unpredictable sea conditions and fluctuating raw material availability. Evaluating advanced brine concentration sensors and automated crystallization monitoring is underway.
answers.pastInitiatives: We piloted a cloud-based project management tool last year, but adoption was inconsistent across teams and we ultimately reverted to spreadsheets and email for most project tracking. This experience highlighted that effective change management and establishing clear documentation requirements are critical before attempting any technology adoption.
answers.strategicGoals: Our industry is facing structural decline due to technological disruption and changing consumer behavior, particularly in food-grade salt purity standards. We cannot rely on incremental improvements to our legacy business — we need to identify entirely new value propositions that leverage our brand reputation, unique operational capabilities, or customer relationships in adjacent spaces where demand is growing.
answers.additionalContext: As a small operation in a highly regulated sector, Aether faces intense scrutiny regarding environmental compliance and operational safety. The reliance on manual processes makes scaling difficult while maintaining the precision required for food-grade products.
answers.teamSize: The innovation function is informal — one senior engineer has been given permission to spend 20% of their time exploring new technologies and prototyping ideas, but this allocation is frequently interrupted by production incidents and urgent feature requests. We have no dedicated innovation budget beyond standard cloud infrastructure costs.

opportunities.title: Precision Monitoring Implementation
opportunities.rationale: Integrate low-cost IoT sensors for real-time brine concentration monitoring to reduce material loss and optimize evaporation cycles without major CAPEX.

first_actions: Conduct a feasibility study on two leading sensor technologies.
Purchase pilot units for testing in one operational pan.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: $5,000 for hardware and initial software integration.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a 3% reduction in evaporation-related material loss within 6 months.
milestones: Data analysis report on efficiency gains (Month 4).

opportunities.title: Desalination Technology Licensing/Partnership
opportunities.rationale: Explore strategic partnerships or licensing opportunities in the emerging desalination technology sector, leveraging Aether's unique expertise in large-scale marine evaporation and brine management. This shifts focus from commodity salt production to specialized mineral recovery.

first_actions: Identify three potential tech partners specializing in reverse osmosis or solar stills.
Develop a high-level business case focusing on adjacent market penetration.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: $10,000 for consulting/legal review and initial pitch materials.
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure one formal pilot or partnership agreement by the end of Year 2.

opportunities.title: Specialty Chemical Line Development
opportunities.rationale: Leverage existing salt refining expertise to diversify into high-purity specialty salts or industrial additives for niche markets like pharmaceuticals or specialized food ingredients.

first_actions: Conduct market research on three non-traditional applications for refined Aether salt products.
Develop a small, proof-of-concept formulation using existing refining equipment.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: $3,000 for sample production and regulatory testing fees.
Time allocation from the senior engineer (20% residual).
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful launch of one specialty product line achieving 5% of new annual revenue within 18 months.
milestones: Initial production run of specialty product (Month 9).

next_steps.action: Establish a formal, documented R&D pipeline framework.
Initiate feasibility study for Desalination partnership target identification.

key_weaknesses: Lack of dedicated funding beyond operational needs (4% budget constraint).
Highly informal innovation process leading to inconsistent change management.
Low digital maturity inhibiting data-driven decision-making for new ventures.
High regulatory compliance burden constraining radical exploration.
